blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal.

blocks.text: Looking across the period, Detached houses: 7 sold over 4 months against an average of 13.0 listed, about 7.4 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was July with 3 sold. Condos and townhomes: 4 sold over 4 months against an average of 11.2 listed, about 11.2 months of listings at that pace; the busiest month was August with 4 sold.

items.t: Burnaby Hospital condos and townhomes for sale

faq.a: It is a GVR MLS® sub-area named for Burnaby Hospital, 3935 Kincaid St — the residential streets around the hospital campus in central Burnaby, south of Canada Way and west of Deer Lake. It is not a separate City community-plan name.

faq.q: What is happening with Burnaby Hospital?
faq.a: A multi-phase redevelopment: Phase 1 delivered a new six-storey pavilion with 83 beds and an expanded support facilities building, and on September 21, 2026 the Province announced a renewed plan with $210 million for an expanded emergency department and surgical unit, with expanded cancer care and a new acute-care tower to follow.

faq.q: Which schools serve a Burnaby Hospital-area address?
faq.a: It depends on the address. SD41 schools in or beside the sub-area include Douglas Road Elementary (K–7), 4861 Canada Way, Cascade Heights Elementary (K–7) at the south side and Burnaby Central Secondary (8–12), 6011 Deer Lake Parkway, at the east side; catchments are address-based and must be checked in the SD41 locator.

faq.q: Is there SkyTrain in the Burnaby Hospital area?
faq.a: No station sits inside the sub-area. Buses serve Kincaid Street at the hospital campus, and Fraser Health directs riders to TransLink for bus information during redevelopment construction.
